content: Spring Boot WebSocket+STOMP uses SimpMessagingTemplate to broadcast to topic destinations (e.g. /topic/session/{code}) subscribed to by all participants in a lobby; SimpSubscriptionRegistry tracks active subscriptions per session. Single-instance in-memory SimpleBroker is sufficient for small apps; multi-instance deployments need a broker relay (RabbitMQ) or Redis pub/sub for fan-out across nodes.
